    # when the car is traveling at speed j meters per second after i seconds.
    dp = [[0] * (v1 + d + 1) for _ in range(t + 1)]

    dp[0][v1] = 0

        for j in range(max(0, v1 - d), min(v1 + d + 1, v2 + d + 1)):

    return max(dp[t][v2 - d:v2 + d + 1])
